claims.text: In Anambra, a court will not order a tenant to leave unless suitable alternative accommodation is available for them.
A landlord may not resort to self-help to evict a tenant in Anambra.
Unlawful eviction in Anambra is actionable in damages.

post.headline: Your landlord wants you out by Christmas in Anambra
lines: This week, a Lagos landlord reportedly faced trouble after a huge rent increase.
In Anambra, if your landlord wants you out, the court must be satisfied you have a place to go.
No order for recovery of possession may be made unless alternative accommodation is available
Landlords cannot use self-help, and unlawful eviction means damages (anambra:protections:1).
post.cta: Send this to a friend whose landlord is giving them trouble in Anambra.

threads.text: A tenant in Anambra was asked to pack out before Christmas. Her landlord says 'my house, my rules'. But in Anambra, the law says a court cannot order you out unless suitable alternative accommodation is available. Landlords cannot use self-help. Unlawful eviction leads to damages. What is your biggest rent fear?
threads.evening: A landlord in Anambra cannot just force you out. The law requires a court to verify alternative accommodation is available before an eviction order. Self-help is unlawful and carries damages.

short.title: Don't let your landlord keep your tenancy agreement copy.
short.hook_say: Your landlord gave you a Tenancy Agreement to sign, but kept all the copies. Why? Because a signed copy is your proof of rent paid and rights. Don't let them deny you this.

tips.say: Always demand a signed copy of your Tenancy Agreement. It is your right and crucial proof of your tenancy terms in Anambra.
Your agreement supports your rent receipts. Both documents work together to prove your payments and tenancy details.
The agreement outlines vital clauses: your notice period, rent amount, and any specific terms that protect you as a tenant.
Having your own copy helps avoid future disputes. Paper beats memory every time. Make your free Tenancy Agreement today.

short.hook_text: DON'T LET YOUR LANDLORD KEEP YOUR TENANCY AGREEMENT COPY.
